battle.name: 第三次意大利獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 維羅納卡斯托扎與威尼西亞戰線
battle.brief: 一八六六年四月至七月，義大利在加富爾推動下向奧地利開戰，主戰場是維羅納西南的卡斯托扎，六月二十四日拉·馬爾莫拉統率的中意大利軍被拉德茨基與本德克擊潰。卡面雷管步槍是當時歐洲步槍的技術基準：意軍以卡爾卡諾雷管槍列陣，奧軍用前膛雷管槍據守山脊，勝負卻不在槍，而在工兵爆破與指揮。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的三方是撒丁王國領銜的義大利王國聯軍、奧地利帝國，以及並未在義大利地面作戰卻決定全局的普魯士。義大利方面，維克托·伊曼紐爾二世以國王身分主持國政，加富爾任首相並掌握外交，陸軍沿用撒丁王國的師團制改編為軍團制，野戰兵力拆成拉·馬爾莫拉指揮的中意大利軍與恰爾迪尼指揮的威尼西亞軍，另有加里波第率領的阿爾卑斯獵兵與皇家志願兵；編制整齊、梯隊完整，但多數步兵團仍配舊式滑膛前膛槍。奧地利方面由哈布斯堡王朝的奧地利帝國作戰，維也納以拉德茨基元帥坐鎮梯形要塞群，兵站與物資靠南方鐵路維繫，本德克任義大利戰區總指揮，麾下為第六軍團、第十一軍團與克萊姆·馬爾蒂尼茨的預備隊，要塞由維羅納、佩斯基耶拉、萊尼亞戈與曼圖亞互相支援。普魯士沒有把地面部隊派入義大利，只把這條戰線當作牽制奧軍的支點，由莫爾特克以三路軍團在薩克森與波希米亞集結，俾斯麥則以德國問題必須先解決為前提。拿破崙三世率領的法國宣布中立，卻把遠征軍擺上萊茵河。歸根究柢，義大利要的是威尼斯與特倫托，奧地利要守住威尼斯王國的餘地與德意志聯邦的席位，普魯士要從德國和奧地利手上奪回主導權，三方各懷算盤，才在同一年夏天同時開火。
countriesEn: The three parties to the conflict were the Kingdom of Italy led by the Kingdom of Sardinia, the Austrian Empire, and Prussia, which fought no ground battle in Italy yet decided the outcome. On the Italian side Victor Emmanuel II presided over the state as king, Cavour served as prime minister and directed foreign policy, and the army was reorganized from the Sardinian division system into a corps system. The field forces were split between the Army of Central Italy under La Marmora and the Army of the Veneto under Cialdini, with the Alpine hunters of Garibaldi and the Royal Volunteers added on top. The order of battle was tidy and the echelons complete, yet most infantry regiments still carried old smoothbore muzzle-loading muskets. Austria fought as the Habsburg Austrian Empire: Vienna kept Radetzky in charge of the quadrilateral fortresses, with supply and stores tied to the southern railway, while Benedek commanded the Italian theater with the VI and XI Corps and the reserve of Clam-Martinic, and the fortresses of Verona, Peschiera, Legnago and Mantua supported one another. Prussia sent no ground troops into Italy but treated this front as a pivot for pinning the Austrian army, concentrating three lines of corps in Saxony and Bohemia under Moltke, while Bismarck assumed that the German question had to be settled first. France under Napoleon III declared itself neutral yet moved the Army of the Rhine to the river. In the last analysis Italy wanted Venetia and the Trentino, Austria wanted to hold what remained of the Kingdom of Lombardy-Venetia together with its seat in the German Confederation, and Prussia wanted to take the lead in Germany away from both; each party had its own arithmetic, and that is why they all went to war in the same summer.
people: 關鍵人物分成義大利、奧地利與普魯士三條線。義大利一邊，首相卡富爾是整場戰爭的設計者，他說服國王維克托·伊曼紐爾二世於一八六六年四月二十一日在議會宣布開戰，並以同盟交換威尼斯；同年六月六日他因病去世，直到最後一天都沒能見到威尼斯歸屬義大利。接替他的是拉·馬爾莫拉，此人一面在中意大利軍前線統兵，一面以內閣首腦身分收拾局面，卡斯托扎慘敗後引咎辭職。恰爾迪尼是威尼西亞一路的主帥，六月底才把分散的隊伍集結起來向東推進。加里波第帶領阿爾卑斯獵兵在山區作戰，屢次以小股部隊遲滯奧軍，卻因與軍部不睦而在西線難有建樹。奧地利方面，老元帥拉德茨基主持米尼西奧河防線，本德克接任戰區總指揮，薩多瓦落敗後被解除職務，皇族阿爾布雷希特元帥七月五日抵前線接掌全局，第四軍團的加布倫茨則自波希米亞方向兼程趕援。普魯士方面，威廉一世親赴戰場，總參謀長莫爾特克以三軍會攻的計畫取勝，戰爭部長羅恩負責動員，俾斯麥在幕後推動外交。海軍方面，義大利海軍總長佩爾薩諾指揮兩支分艦隊在亞得里亞海尋找決戰，海利薩一役則是奧地利提戈特霍夫以斐迪南·馬克斯號衝角得手。
peopleEn: The key figures run along three lines. On the Italian side, Prime Minister Cavour was the designer of the whole war: he persuaded Victor Emmanuel II to declare war in parliament on 21 April 1866, and he traded an alliance for Venetia. He fell ill and died on 6 June of the same year, never living to see Venetia pass to Italy. His successor was La Marmora, who commanded the Army of Central Italy in the field and simultaneously headed the cabinet as the campaign fell apart; after the defeat at Custoza he resigned. Cialdini was the commander of the Venetian front, and only at the end of June did he gather his scattered formations for the drive east. Garibaldi led the Alpine hunters in the mountains, repeatedly holding up the Austrians with small forces, yet he achieved little on the western front because of his quarrels with the general staff. On the Austrian side the old Marshal Radetzky directed the Mincio line; Benedek took over as theatre commander, was defeated at Sadowa and was then relieved; the archduke Albrecht reached the front on 5 July to assume overall command, while Gablenz of the IV Corps hurried to the rescue from Bohemia. On the Prussian side Wilhelm I came to the battlefield, Chief of the General Staff Moltke won with his plan of a converging attack by three armies, War Minister Roon ran the mobilisation, and Bismarck pushed the diplomacy from behind the scenes. At sea the Italian Admiral Persano commanded two divisions searching for a decisive engagement in the Adriatic, while the Austrian Tegetthoff won at Lissa by ramming the enemy with the Erzherzog Ferdinand Max.
kits: 卡面這件雷管步槍是法國一八四〇年型的技術代表。法國在一八三〇年代中期完成火燧改雷管，一八四〇年前後全軍換裝，到一八六六年仍是法軍制式步槍的基準，戰爭中法國陳兵萊茵、保持中立，手上握的正是這種槍。雷管的價值在於擊發可靠，霧天與夜間不必像火槍那樣先點燃火絨，因此到一八六〇年代中期各國幾乎同步換裝，同一套擊發原理也催生了普軍的針發槍與奧軍的洛倫茲槍，技術同源，射擊速率與訓練卻差得很遠。義大利軍隊以自製的卡爾卡諾一八六〇年型與一八六一年型雷管步槍為主力，十一毫米口徑，另有數量可觀的舊式滑膛前膛槍與少量英國製恩菲爾、惠特沃思步槍；奧地利軍用一八五九年維恩德爾前膛雷管槍，此時正換裝一八六二年洛倫茲針刺槍；普軍主力是一八四一年型針發槍與一八六二年改型，用紙包定裝藥，但一八四〇型老步槍仍大量配發到各師。火炮方面奧軍野戰砲數量多於意軍，義軍以六磅與十二磅前膛速射砲配屬軍團；攻城器材包括爆破藥包、攻城砲與工兵器材車，運輸靠鐵路、騾車與牛車，野戰醫療設有野戰醫院與救護車。海軍的分野在鐵甲與後膛砲：義大利裝甲艦裝英國製後膛砲，奧地利分艦隊同樣配備英國阿姆斯特朗後膛砲。
kitsEn: The card shows a French percussion rifle of the 1840 pattern, the technical representative of its kind. France completed the change from flint to percussion in the mid-1830s and changed over the whole army around 1840, so that the percussion rifle was still the standard arm of the French infantry in 1866; it was exactly this weapon that France held on the Rhine while it stayed neutral. The value of percussion ignition is reliability of firing: in fog and at night there is no need to light a match cord as with a musket, so by the mid-1860s every power had changed over almost at the same moment. The same principle produced the Prussian needle gun and the Austrian Lorenz rifle, technologically of one family, yet with a very different rate of fire and a very different standard of training. The Italian army relied mainly on its own Carcano rifles of the 1860 and 1861 patterns, 11 mm calibre, together with a substantial quantity of old smoothbore muzzle-loaders and a few British Enfield and Whitworth rifles; the Austrians used the 1859 Werndl percussion muzzleloader while exchanging it for the 1862 Lorenz needle rifle; the Prussians fielded the 1841 needle gun and its 1862 improvement, firing paper cartridges, yet the old Model 1840 musket was still distributed to divisions in large numbers. In artillery the Austrians had more field guns than the Italians, who attached 6-pounder and 12-pounder muzzle-loading quick-firing guns to their corps; siege equipment included blasting charges, siege guns and engineer wagons, transport rested on railways, mule carts and ox carts, and field hospitals and ambulances served the wounded. At sea the difference lay in armour and in breech-loading guns: the Italian ironclads carried British-made breech loaders, and the Austrian squadron was likewise armed with British Armstrong breech-loading guns.
tactics: 義大利的計畫是三路並進：加富爾主張在線上同時攻取梯形要塞的兩翼，拉·馬爾莫拉力主以一次正面決戰解決戰局，加里波第的獵兵則在山區切斷敵後。卡斯托扎一役最能說明問題：六月二十四日拂曉，意軍以拉·馬爾莫拉的主力在維羅納以西展開正面進攻，步兵在起伏的丘陵地帶被地形切斷，攻勢屢屢停頓；工兵奉命爆破山脊上的奧軍火砲，第一枚炸藥啞火，第二枚雖爆炸卻未毀砲，反炸傷己方人員；工兵營與步兵的配合、砲兵與工兵的銜接都顯得生硬。威尼西亞戰線是另一種節奏，恰爾迪尼六月底才完成集結，七月一日強渡皮亞韋河，七月四日在貝澤格取得戰術勝利，把奧軍逐向特倫托方向。普軍的戰術最有章法：莫爾特克以火車把三路軍團分批調到波希米亞，形成三面合圍，縱隊行軍途中完成展開；步兵採取先建立射擊線再一次衝鋒的連續躍進，針發槍可臥倒裝填，射擊速率明顯高於前膛槍；薩多瓦一役的關鍵是萊恩葡萄園方向的側翼攻擊，密集預備射擊之後，步兵逐連躍進，一鼓攻入。奧軍的反擊靠快速行軍與整個軍團的整齊應援，但各團聯絡差，一支部隊被突破便連帶崩潰。海軍方面，佩爾薩諾把艦隊分成南北兩部企圖封鎖亞得里亞，提戈特霍夫以蒸汽機車搶先抵達戰位，在海利薩實施衝角，義軍因兵力分散全線失序。補給線上，奧軍靠維羅納的南方鐵路逐次輸送，普軍以鐵路與郵車組成縱隊，義軍在山區大量依賴騾車與人力。
tacticsEn: The Italian plan had three prongs: Cavour wanted simultaneous attacks on both wings of the quadrilateral fortresses, La Marmora insisted on settling the war with one frontal decisive battle, and Garibaldi's hunters were to cut the enemy's rear in the mountains. The battle of Custoza shows the problem most clearly. At dawn on 24 June the Italian main army under La Marmora launched a frontal attack west of Verona, but the infantry was broken up by the rolling hill country and the assault stalled again and again. Sappers were ordered to blow up the Austrian guns on the ridge: the first charge failed to detonate, and the second, though it exploded, did not destroy the gun and instead killed Italian personnel; the working of the sapper companies, and the junction between artillery and engineers, both looked raw. The Venetian front ran to a different rhythm. Cialdini completed his concentration only at the end of June, forced the Piave on 1 July, and gained a tactical victory at Bezegg on 4 July, driving the Austrians back toward the Trentino. The Prussians had the most methodical tactics of all: Moltke moved three lines of corps to Bohemia by train in successive echelons to form a three-sided convergence, completing deployment while the columns were still on the march. Their infantry used the sequence of establishing a firing line and then charging in a single bound, and because the needle gun could be loaded lying down its rate of fire was visibly above that of the muzzleloader; the decisive moment at Sadowa was the flank attack through the Laun vineyards, where a dense preparatory barrage was followed by the advance of the skirmishing line company by company and a rush that carried the position. The Austrian counterstroke depended on rapid marching and the timely support of whole corps, but the corps were poorly in touch with one another, and once one formation was broken the collapse spread. At sea Persano split his fleet into a northern and a southern half to blockade the Adriatic, while Tegetthoff used his steamers to reach the line of battle first and ram at Lissa; the Italians, scattered and unable to concentrate, fell into disorder along the whole front. In logistics the Austrians fed the line from the southern railway out of Verona, the Prussians moved in columns by train and stage-coach, and the Italians in the mountains relied heavily on mule carts and manpower.
data: 意軍作戰初期可用兵力約十三萬五千人，分成中意大利軍與威尼西亞軍兩大集團，卡斯托扎一役實際投入的野戰兵力約十萬人，奧軍方面約六萬至八萬人。卡斯托扎之後，意軍損失合計約一萬六千人，分為陣亡、受傷、被俘與散失四類，具體分項各家統計出入頗大；奧軍損失約二千人。義軍在威尼西亞方向推進的距離，前後約一百二十公里，最遠抵達特倫托南緣的蒙特弗雷戈索一帶，時間是七月二十四日。普軍與奧軍在薩多瓦一役投入的野戰兵力各在二十萬上下，總計超過四十萬人；普軍傷亡約九千人，奧軍損失約四萬四千人，其中被俘約二萬一千人。整場戰爭自四月二十日打到七月二十四日，前後三個月零數天；若只計普奧交火，自六月十四日普軍進入薩克森算起，約三十五天。距離上，卡斯托扎前線縱深不過十公里上下，而普軍把遠在波蘭與薩克森的部隊用鐵路調到波希米亞，行程數百公里，最長的一支縱隊只用了一週左右。義大利海軍在海利薩投入的裝甲艦為數艘，其中意大利國王號編制約四百人，一役之後大部艦沉。
dataEn: Italy had roughly 135,000 men available at the opening of the campaign, divided into the two great groupings of the Army of Central Italy and the Army of the Veneto, of whom about 100,000 were actually deployed in the field at Custoza against an Austrian force of roughly 60,000 to 80,000. After Custoza the Italians had lost about 16,000 men in all — killed, wounded, captured and missing — and the breakdown differs considerably between the counts; the Austrians lost about 2,000. The Italian advance in the Venetian direction covered on the order of 120 kilometres, reaching as far as Montefregoso at the southern edge of the Trentino on 24 July. At Sadowa the Prussians and Austrians each brought around 200,000 men into the field, more than 400,000 in all; the Prussians suffered about 9,000 casualties and the Austrians about 44,000, of whom some 21,000 were taken prisoner. The campaign ran from 20 April to 24 July, a little over three months; counting only the Austro-Prussian war from the Prussian entry into Saxony on 14 June, about thirty-five days. In terms of distance, the front at Custoza was barely ten kilometres deep, while the Prussians moved troops from Poland and Saxony to Bohemia by rail over several hundred kilometres, the longest column taking about a week. The Italian squadron committed at Lissa comprised a handful of ironclads, of which the Re d'Italia carried a complement of about four hundred, and she was lost with the greater part of her crew.
cause: 戰爭的直接導火線在北方不在南方。一八六六年初，普魯士提出改組德意志聯邦的新方案，把聯邦軍與外交權收歸普魯士之手，奧地利拒絕，因為那會直接動搖它在德國的影響；三月談判破裂，普魯士於六月十四日出兵薩克森與漢諾威，德意志聯邦的多數邦隨之倒向普國，奧地利被排除在德國事務之外。義大利在這個窗口裡得到一個難得的機會：一八五九年法奧戰爭之後，倫巴第併入撒丁王國，但威尼斯仍被法國佔領，一八六六年法國自感腹背受敵，願意將威尼斯交還；俾斯麥在國內經歷政變危機後急需盟友，卡富爾則需要普國的軍力對付奧地利。兩人於五月在倫敦達成默契：意軍在北方開火，進攻奧地利在倫巴第與威尼西亞的軍隊，普國承擔奧地利在德國戰場的壓力，並默許威尼斯最終歸義大利。深層的原因是義大利國家認同的成形：加里波第於一八六〇年遠征西西里與那不勒斯、國王接管義大利王國之後，輿論要求把北部的統一完成，三年一戰的模式已被人們視為可行的道路。
causeEn: The immediate spark lay in the north, not the south. At the beginning of 1866 Prussia put forward a plan to reorganise the German Confederation, bringing the federal army and the foreign policy of the Confederation into her own hands; Austria refused, for that would have shaken her influence in Germany at its root. Negotiations broke down in March, Prussia marched into Saxony and Hanover on 14 June, and most of the states of the Confederation turned to Prussia, leaving Austria outside German affairs. Italy found a rare opening in that window. After the Franco-Austrian war of 1859 Lombardy had been annexed to the Kingdom of Sardinia, but Venice was still held by France, and in 1866, feeling squeezed from two sides, France was willing to hand it back; Bismarck, after the upheaval at home, badly needed an ally, and Cavour needed Prussian weight against Austria. The two men reached an understanding in London in May: Italy would open a front in the north and attack the Austrian armies in Lombardy and Venetia, Prussia would bear the Austrian pressure on the German theatre, and Venice would in the end be allowed to go to Italy. Beneath all of this lay the formation of Italian national identity: after Garibaldi's expedition to Sicily and Naples in 1860 and the king's assumption of the Kingdom of Italy, public opinion demanded the completion of unification in the north, and the pattern of one war every three years had come to be regarded as a workable road.
impact: 威尼斯於一八六六年七月由義方官員接管，十月三日維也納和約正式確認歸屬；特倫托卻仍然留在奧地利手中，成為未竟之業，日後義大利民族主義把未完成的那一半寫進政治，直到二十世紀仍在發酵。軍事層面上，卡斯托扎的慘敗讓義大利陸軍的問題集中爆發：指揮脫節、兵種配合生硬、砲兵與工兵缺乏銜接、部隊裝備新舊參差，改革呼聲高漲，一八六七年後軍制與後勤逐步整頓，一八七〇年攻入羅馬的軍隊已由拉·馬爾莫拉指揮。政治層面上，一八六六年七月的普選給執政的右翼沉重打擊，加富爾留下的政黨分裂，內閣幾度更替。歐洲層面，普魯士主動促成北德意志聯邦，一八六七年成立，奧地利退出德國事務，列強的均勢被重新排列；俾斯麥與拿破崙三世在比亞里茨的會談更定下法國對普魯士的默契，為普法戰爭埋下種子。技術面上，針發槍與後膛砲在同一年夏天分別在陸地與海上證明價值，歐洲的軍備競賽再沒有踩煞車的理由。
impactEn: Venice was taken over by Italian officials in July 1866 and formally confirmed as Italian by the Treaty of Vienna on 3 October; the Trentino, however, remained in Austrian hands, an unfinished business. Italian nationalism later wrote that unfinished half into its politics, where it continued to work until the twentieth century. On the military side the disaster of Custoza exposed the faults of the Italian army in concentrated form: broken command, clumsy coordination between arms, poor work between artillery and engineers, and hopelessly mixed old and new equipment. The pressure for reform rose accordingly, and after 1866 the army system and logistics were gradually put in order; the force that took Rome in 1870 was under La Marmora. On the political side the general election of July 1866 was a heavy defeat for the governing right wing, the party Cavour had built split apart, and the cabinet changed hands more than once. Across Europe Prussia pressed ahead with the creation of the North German Confederation in 1867, Austria was pushed out of German business, and the balance among the great powers was rearranged; the meeting between Bismarck and Napoleon III at Biarritz fixed the terms of French acquiescence toward Prussia and planted the seed of the Franco-Prussian war. In technical terms the needle gun and the breech-loading gun had each proved their worth, on land and at sea, in the same summer, and there was no longer any good reason for Europe to put the brakes on the arms race.
result: 戰爭有三個戰場、三種結局。北方德意志戰場上，普魯士在七月三日的薩多瓦會戰中以三軍合擊擊敗奧軍，迫使奧地利求和；義大利戰場上，奧地利靠拉·馬爾莫拉的失利守住了米尼西奧河防線，義軍全軍潰退，威尼西亞方向也未能包抄成功；亞得里亞海上，奧地利海軍以斐迪南·馬克斯號衝沉意大利國王號，義大利海軍的攻勢瓦解。就義大利本身而言，這是一場勝負各半的戰爭：北方線取敗、南方線得地、而對維也納與威尼斯方向的攻勢徹底失敗。八月二十三日布拉格條約奠定德意志的格局，十月三日維也納和約把威尼斯交給義大利；普軍勝利後的停戰消息傳到威尼斯戰線，義軍沒有立刻收手，七月二十四日的蒙特弗雷戈索戰役成為這場戰爭在義大利境內的最後一仗。義大利統一的目標沒有完成——特倫托仍在奧地利手中，羅馬仍歸教廷，一八七〇年才由拉·馬爾莫拉率軍攻下羅馬，把一八六六年留下的問題收尾。
resultEn: The war had three battlefields and three outcomes. On the German front Prussia beat Austria at Sadowa on 3 July with a converging attack by three armies and forced a peace. On the Italian front Austria held the Mincio line thanks to La Marmora's defeat, the Italian army broke up completely, and the drive from the Venetian side failed to turn the Austrian position. In the Adriatic the Austrian squadron sank the Re d'Italia at Lissa with the Erzherzog Ferdinand Max, and the Italian offensive at sea collapsed. For Italy itself it was a war drawn in every quarter: a lost battle in the north, ground gained in the east, and a shattered offensive in the Viennese and Venetian direction. The Treaty of Prague of 23 August settled the German arrangement, and the Treaty of Vienna of 3 October handed Venice over to Italy. Even after the news of the Austro-Prussian armistice reached the Venetian front the Italians did not stop at once, and the battle of Montefregoso on 24 July was the last engagement fought on Italian soil in this war. Italian unification was not complete: the Trentino was still Austrian and Rome still belonged to the papacy, and it was in 1870, when La Marmora's army entered Rome, that the account left open in 1866 was finally closed.
